pkgmetadata.longdescription: cVisor is an in-process Linux sandbox for untrusted or LLM-generated code, isolating programs by intercepting Linux syscalls from userspace (seccomp user-notifier) instead of using a VM or container.

use.flag: Also build the cvisord gRPC/GraphQL daemon
Install libcvisor.so, the C ABI used by the language SDKs
